text:
Doctor is a trader specialized in medicine and holds an improvised clinic inside abandoned school building in Area 05.

After visiting the Grandma for an "welfare check", Doctor returns to this clinic and is ready to provide medical services for the injured ones.

ドクターは医療を専門とするトレーダーで、エリア05の廃校舎内に即席の診療所を開いている。

name: Description
text:
Last week I visited the Doctor in that abandoned school building nearby. He told me that I should cut all my "bad habits", but the old fucker smokes himself, so screw him!

You're probably just one of those modern-day hippies who only licks mint pastilles when things get rough, but if you happen to find one of these, bring a pack or two and some matches as well.
translation:
先週、近所の廃校になった建物にいる医者のところへ行ったんだ。あいつは俺に「悪い癖」を全部やめるべきだなんて言うけど、あのクソジジイ、自分でもタバコを吸ってるくせに。ふん、知ったことか！

君はたぶん、ピンチの時にミントの錠剤を舐めるだけの、いわゆる現代のヒッピーの一人なんだろうけど、もしこれを見つけたら、パックを一、二箱とマッチも持ってきてくれ。
